blocks.text: South Korean artist and 2NE1 leader CL has officially signed an exclusive contract with THEBLACKLABEL, reuniting with longtime producer Teddy Park ahead of a major musical comeback. Following the agency announcement, CL revealed that her new digital single, “ICONIC,” will drop on November 20 at 6 p.m. KST. She will also make her grand return to the MAMA Awards stage at the Kyocera Dome in Osaka, Japan, during the November 20–21 ceremony.
